paper_title: Constraints on axion-like particles from X-ray observations of Hydra galaxy cluster
notes: Astrophysical bound from photon/ALP oscillations in Hydra cluster magnetic field, Chandra X-ray data. Main flat constraint g < 8.3e-12 GeV^-1 for m_a < 7e-12 eV (95% CL), rising as m_a^2 at higher masses with a slight weakening feature near 8e-12 eV where m_a ~ effective photon mass. Rising-branch points are approximate reads from Figure 4 (x-axis in 10^-12 eV, y-axis in 10^-11 GeV^-1).
